- Astra_MAP_v4.xlsx (MAP with milestones, owners, acceptance criteria)

Emily / Rajiv —

Thanks for the quick response. Quick updates and confirmations: 

1) Dry run: We can host a full rehearsal on Thu Aug 20 09:00-12:00 PDT. Please confirm; I’ll send a calendar invite and agenda.
2) Schema logging: Connor has added structured ingestion logs and a mapping note in the runbook; see attached runbook v2. The runbook includes a validation checklist that your team can run during the rehearsal.
3) SOC2 attestation: Marissa will send a DocuSign link (attached in related links) once she finalizes the evidence bundle. We recommend the attestation be signed by procurement by Aug 12 to keep the timeline.

Runbook highlights (excerpt):
- Pre-cutover checks: feature-flag off, ingestion smoke test, latency baseline capture
- Cutover window: 02:00 - 04:00 PDT on 2026-08-24 (target low-traffic)
- Verification: smoke-tests (ingest validation + end-to-end inference), acceptance sign-off (Astra PM)
- Rollback plan: revert traffic to canary pool, invalidate caches, rollback model variant to v1.2, expected RTO 30m
- Escalation contact: Sean Gallagher (redwood on-call) + 24/7 ops hotline

Attachments: cutover_runbook_v2.md, updated MAP (Astra_MAP_v4.xlsx).

DocuSign link included in related links above. Let us know if the Aug 20 dry run window works and if you can confirm procurement will sign by Aug 12.

Best,
Soojin
